arStrings.szText: {c_important}Sever{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_16} * 100|%|]{/c} of its initial damage along its path and Slows enemies by {c_number}[{SF_33} |%|]{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_34}]{/c} seconds.
Casting {c_important}Sever{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_13} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage for each Minion you have and spawns a Corpse at its end point.
Every {c_number}3rd{/c} cast of {c_important}Sever{/c} Fears enemies and makes them {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_14}]{/c} seconds.
